_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest for the r2 SIGINT race proof (issue #1457 / #1783). Read by apps/front/scripts/ci/run-proofs.mts BEFORE classification. Each test declared in `expectedRed` MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code. If a declared kept-red test PASSES, the runner fails CI with verdict CORRUPT PROOF — even if other tests in the file still fail with assertion errors. This is the r8 fix for the angle mort identified in #1863, scoped to this proof file. Generalization to the rest of the repo lives in #1863.

expectedRed.testName: the r2 fixture writes the handshake BEFORE installing the SIGINT handler, OR the handler is wrapped in an async deferral (the buggy ordering the fix corrected)
expectedRed.why: On correct code, the handler line precedes the handshake line AND the handler is a direct process.on(...) call. bugPresent is therefore false and the assertion `expect(bugPresent).toBe(true)` fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the bug has been REINTRODUCED (handler appears after handshake, or the handler is wrapped in a deferral).

expectedRed.testName: the detection pipeline (findHandlerLine + isHandlerDeferred) classifies the real handler — a regression on either mechanism turns this red
expectedRed.why: On correct code, the structural assertion `expect(isHandlerDeferred(deferredLine)).toBe(false)` fails because isHandlerDeferred correctly classifies the setImmediate-wrapped line as deferred. If this test passes, isHandlerDeferred has been weakened to accept all lines as non-deferred (always-false) — the proof cannot measure the bug.
